standfirst: Alpharetrovirus is the avian genus — avian leukosis virus and the sarcoma viruses that carry a transduced oncogene. It is the simplest layout in the family, gag-pol-env with no accessory genes, and the only one of the four retroviral modules whose fourth feature is a captured host kinase rather than a viral regulator.

modules.Alpharetrovirus: src is the fourth gene of non-defective Rous sarcoma virus, 3′ of env and fully collinear — a single tblastn HSP covers residues 1–526 at 93–100% identity. It was never called in the deposited vocabulary; the literature probe turned it up. It is built from 5 unique sequences with a minimum cluster size of 3 rather than the default 5, and the identity floor is untouched.

gaps: SRC is called on a small minority of exemplars and that is correct biology, not a gap: src is present only in non-defective sarcoma viruses. Sweeping all 294 holdings with nine curated Swiss-Prot v-Src queries finds nine carriers scoring 937–1102 bits and nothing above 69 — a clean break, so the carrier set is bounded. SRC therefore does not take copy_num. Its profile is sound independently of its rate: it recalls 5 of 5 of its own collection, and the real caller annotated it on a held-out carrier at the expected position and length.
